correctness.rationale: The proof constructs all 27 line classes and 45 tritangents, selects 21 actual triples, performs reversible integer elimination to Z^7/<3H−sum E_i>, checks all omitted triples in this quotient, and uses the standard unimodular Picard pairing and primitive E6 perpendicular lattice. Replayed package checker gives a +1 minor and integral expressions for all 45 columns; no finite experiment is substituted for a proof about all smooth complex cubics.

originality.rationale: The established rational E6 weight/tritangent correspondence is explicitly excluded as a contribution. The claimed increment is the saturated integral equality of relation modules and a concrete unimodular minimal 21-tritangent basis; neither follows from the cited rational span alone. Targeted searches and material inspection found no explicit equivalent result, although a broad weight-lattice/circuit treatment could subsume it.
residual_risks: The new integral statement may be an immediate, previously implicit consequence of a general integral minuscule-weight presentation not located in the searches.
Recent work on full signed circuits may contain an equivalent relation basis in an uninspected appendix.
